concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured [[source-adyen-docs-payouts]] landing page defines a broader Payouts umbrella: a Payments-combined Payout Service for an Adyen merchant of record paying a beneficiary not onboarded with Adyen, and a separate Adyen for Platforms route for payouts of processed payments to platform merchants or sub-merchants. The child routes own their distinct eligibility, APIs and payout lifecycle; the landing-page “real time” headline is not a completion guarantee.
